atAGlance: Sinh tố xoài is mango smoothie, thick, golden, tropical, and one of the easiest Vietnamese fruit drinks to fall for.
whatItIs: Sinh tố xoài is ripe mango blended with ice and often milk or condensed milk. Expect mango smoothie that is fragrant, sunny, thick, and sweet-tart when the mango is ripe.
howToEnjoy: Ask for less sugar if the mango is already sweet; drink it before the ice thins the texture.
howLocalsOrder: Order sinh tố xoài when you want a rich fruit drink. Ask ít đường, không sữa đặc, or ít đá before blending to control sweetness and thickness.
worthKnowing: Mango smoothie is a reliable way to taste ripe tropical fruit without choosing a mango at the market; it can be thick, creamy, and dessert-sweet.
goodToKnow: Can be very sweet with condensed milk.
